title: zephyr_remote_openocd user configuration
description: User configuration for selecting the Zephyr runner and defining reusable remote OpenOCD connections.

default_runner.description: Runner selected when no other runner is requested. Use remote_openocd to run OpenOCD through a configured remote.

default_remote.description: Name of the remote selected when no --remote argument or environment override is provided.

^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$.description: One reusable group of remote connection settings.

presets.description: Named reusable settings inherited by remotes; a remote field replaces the inherited field as a whole.

remotes.description: Named remote OpenOCD connections selected by command-line, environment, or default selection.

command.title: Command
command.description: An argv sequence passed without shell splitting; the first item is the executable and later items are fixed arguments.

prefixItems.description: Executable name or path used as the first command item.

items.description: One complete command argument; it is not shell-split.

commandArgument.title: Command argument
commandArgument.description: A literal command argument. NUL characters are forbidden; empty strings are allowed after the executable.

commandExecutable.title: Command executable
commandExecutable.description: The first command item: a bare executable name, an absolute path, or a ~/... home-relative path; home interpretation depends on the command.

environment.title: Environment-variable allow-list
environment.description: A unique list of local environment-variable names whose values may be forwarded to remote OpenOCD.

items.description: One environment-variable name, without an equals sign or NUL character.

localPath.title: Local path
localPath.description: An absolute path or a path beginning with ~, interpreted on the contributor's local machine.

remotePath.title: Remote path
remotePath.description: An absolute normalized POSIX path, or a path beginning with ~, interpreted on the remote host.

paths.title: Path mappings
paths.description: A mapping from local absolute or home-relative resource roots to normalized equivalent roots on the remote host.

additionalProperties.description: Equivalent normalized path root on the remote host.

propertyNames.description: Local path root whose contents or references are mapped to the remote destination.

preset.title: Remote preset
preset.description: A reusable partial set of OpenOCD, SSH, environment, and path-mapping settings inherited by a remote.

openocd_command.description: Remote OpenOCD executable and fixed arguments.

ssh_command.description: Local SSH executable and fixed arguments used for every remote action.

forward_env.description: Environment-variable names allowed to reach remote OpenOCD.

remote.title: Remote definition
remote.description: A named remote OpenOCD connection. Fields may inherit from a preset and direct fields replace inherited values as a whole.

preset.description: Name of the preset to inherit before applying fields defined on this remote.

ssh_host.description: Host name or SSH configuration alias passed to the configured SSH command. If omitted, the remote name is used.

openocd_command.description: Remote OpenOCD executable and fixed arguments. A production remote must provide this directly or through its preset.

ssh_command.description: Local SSH executable and fixed arguments. After inheritance, it defaults to [ssh].

forward_env.description: Environment-variable names whose local values may be forwarded to remote OpenOCD. After inheritance, it defaults to an empty list.

path_mappings.description: Local-to-remote resource mappings. After inheritance, it defaults to an empty mapping.
